import sys
from xml.dom import minidom

path = sys.argv[1]
dom = minidom.parse(path)
ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

def q(tag):
    return f"{{{ns}}}{tag}"

paras = dom.getElementsByTagName(q("p"))
print(f"Total paragraphs: {len(paras)}")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName(q("pPr"))
    ppr_xml = pPr[0].toxml()[:300] if pPr else ""
    text = "".join(t.firstChild.nodeValue for r in p.getElementsByTagName(q("r"))
                   for t in r.getElementsByTagName(q("t")) if t.firstChild)
    print(f"--- [{i}] text={text[:80]!r}")
    if ppr_xml:
        print(f"    pPr: {ppr_xml}")

import sys
from xml.dom import minidom

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
path = sys.argv[1]
dom = minidom.parse(path)

def q(tag):
    return f"{{{W}}}{tag}"

def node_text(p):
    return "".join(t.firstChild.nodeValue
                   for t in p.getElementsByTagName(q("t")) if t.firstChild)

paras = dom.getElementsByTagName(q("p"))
changed = []
for p in paras:
    text = node_text(p)
    if text and text.isupper():
        for r in p.getElementsByTagName(q("r")):
            rPrs = r.getElementsByTagName(q("rPr"))
            rPr = rPrs[0] if rPrs else r.insertBefore(dom.createElementNS(W, q("rPr")), r.firstChild)
            existing = rPr.getElementsByTagName(q("u"))
            if existing:
                continue
            u = dom.createElementNS(W, q("u"))
            u.setAttributeNS(W, q("val"), "single")
            rPr.appendChild(u)
        changed.append(text)

with open(path, "wb") as f:
    dom.writexml(f, encoding="ascii")

print(f"Underlined {len(changed)} headlines:")
for t in changed:
    print(" -", t)
